notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one legendary creature and/or planeswalker.
You have enough mana to cast Karn's Temporal Sundering and the self-suspending card, if needed, during the first turn.
easyPrerequisites: You have a storm count of 1 if the self-suspending card is not in your hand, or a storm count of 0 otherwise.
description:
Cast the self-suspending card by paying its mana cost if its in your hand, or any other spell otherwise if you have not cast a spell this turn.
Cast Karn's Temporal Sundering by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Karn's Temporal Sundering and then exiling it with four time counters on it and giving it suspend.
Resolve the copy of Karn's Temporal Sundering, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of that turn's upkeep, Karn's Temporal Sundering and the self-suspending card's suspend abilities trigger, removing a time counter from each of them.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing three time counters from Karn's Temporal Sundering and the self-suspending card, triggering their suspend abilities.
Resolve the self-suspending card's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, and eventually exile it with time counters on it.
Resolve the Karn's Temporal Sundering's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
